title: Stop Forgetting New Words: Give Each One a Picture #shorts
description:
Stop forgetting new words. Give each one a picture.
• Livid: your boss when the printer breaks again
• Swamped: a desk buried in paperwork
• Thrilled: a child on the last day of school
• Exhausted: a runner at the finish line
• Baffled: a cat looking in a mirror

Which picture will you remember tomorrow? Tell me in the comments.
